text.markdown:
Throughout early 2023, the GOSH Community will be working collaboratively on an open hardware literature review as part of the [GOSH 2022 Research and Policy Writing Workshops](https://openhardware.science/gosh-2022-research-and-policy-writing-workshops/). As part of the literature process, we will be holding a series of public calls focused on a particular topic related to open hardware. Each call will consist of a 1-hour public talk on the topic with time for additional comments from the community.

If you are interested in participating in the literature review process, please join us for one of the following calls listed below.

Subscribe to the [GOSH community calendar](https://calendar.google.com/calendar?cid=cWhsZDgzcjkzNWVubHExcGd1M2loZm82N3NAZ3JvdXAuY2FsZW5kYXIuZ29vZ2xlLmNvbQ) to be notified of these sessions and other GOSH-related events and activities.
